content:
A New York politician took on social media users who accused him of being a lizard person, a reptile or an alien after a video of his eye movement went viral over the weekend.

Jordan J.G. Wright — a Democrat representing Harlem in the New York State Assembly — was standing a few feet behind New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani at a press conference on Friday where the mayor announced plans to close the Rikers Island jail complex.

Various clips from the presser show Wright blinking before his eyes roll back around the 1:54 mark in this video from the mayor’s office.

The moment sparked a flood of posts — some with millions of views on X — in which users floated conspiracy theories disputing Wright’s earthly origins.

Wright, a third-generation state politician, responded to the out-of-this-world talk in a statement to the New York Post.

“I have no idea what was going on in that video. I’m really not sure,” he said.

“Obviously I’m a human being, and my humanity can be seen through my legislation like the $4 million for the WE ACT environmental justice center in Harlem,” he added, referring to his support for funding a community center in his district.

“I can’t speak to any reptiles or aliens.”
